title: Electrical attraction
hints: Use force, rather than potential energy.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: The inverse-square law gives $1/2^2=1/4$ of the original force magnitude.
statement:
At fixed charge magnitudes, what happens to the Coulomb force magnitude if separation doubles?

[_]{a}

explanations: This would be an inverse-distance law.
Separation is in the force law.
